subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------C.CONT.
description: Diagram in WI-29, closing the WI section's main argument. (R)INFO-DS — the reality of information dissemination — is crossed with C-CONT (composite continuance). The closing diagram poses what real information dissemination's relationship to composite continuance actually requires structurally — the question that has organized the entire White Improvisor section. INFO-DS → C-CONT (the crossing). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) → T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics); PROJ-DY → C-CONT in parallel. TH-CONT-DY branches to HI-P (high purpose) and COS-P (cosmic particulars). C-CONT → RE-ST (restructuralism). COS-P → TRS (transition). Structural argument: real information dissemination feeds directly into composite continuance, which produces restructuralism. Projectional dynamics is the upstream that produces both the physical-universe → time-continuum → thrust-continuance-dynamics chain *and* feeds composite continuance directly. Thrust continuance dynamics fans into both high purpose and cosmic particulars — meaning the diagram makes Braxton's structural claim diagrammatic: real information dissemination *only* leads to restructuralism (the productive output Braxton wants for the white improvisor) when projectional dynamics is grounded in physical-universe particulars whose time-continuum implications generate thrust-continuance dynamics carrying both high purpose and cosmic particulars. The cosmic-particulars → transition output is the additional channel that makes the chain transformational rather than merely sustaining. The diagram closes the section by specifying exactly what conditions the white improvisor's real information-dissemination would have to meet to become structurally consequential.
